conditions.code_operand_mode: Conditional ordinary IA-32 32-bit code/default operand mode; no operand/address override prefix in the captured bytes.
conditions.instruction_identity: The captured bytes must be the executed bytes at the relevant continuation; runtime identity was not checked.
conditions.listing_to_runtime_linear_identity: Separate unverified assumption I: each saved listing coordinate L equals the runtime linear instruction address.
conditions.CS_base_mapping: Separate unverified mapping: under I, rho(L) = (L - CS.base) mod 2^32. CS.base=0 is sufficient for rho(L)=L.
conditions.nonidentity_mapping: Without I, require an established runtime linear mapping lambda(L), then rho(L)=(lambda(L)-CS.base) mod 2^32.
conditions.stack_address_size: The main equations additionally require SS.B=1 at each relevant instruction; code/default operand size does not establish SS.B.
conditions.normal_completion: Each stated transition requires normal instruction completion, valid segment/stack accesses and no intervening external state change.
conditions.segmented_memory: Read32(M,SS,a) and Write32(M,SS,a,v) use the current stack segment and address translation; SS.base=0 is not assumed.
conditions.call_boundary: No return, stack, memory, register, segment or mode preservation is assumed across C04F67.
conditions.suffix_reestablishes_conditions: If the callee reaches the captured POP, apply the code/stack/normal-completion conditions afresh to that continuation state.

initial_state.initial_top_word: R0 := Read32(M0,SS0,S), only when that access is valid; R0 is not presumed to be a real caller return address.
initial_state.return_offset_symbol: rho := rho(00C04FDC), conditional on an established listing-to-runtime mapping and current CS0.base.
initial_state.addition_convention: u32 arithmetic for ESP/EIP expressions; each memory access still must be valid.

prefix.callee_argument_semantics: No argument type or calling convention follows from the push alone.

prefix.encoded_fact: E8 8B FF FF FF has signed rel32 displacement -117.
prefix.flat_numeric_EIP_special_case: Only under listing/runtime identity and CS0.base=0: pushed EIP=00C04FDC and target EIP=00C04F67.
prefix.layout_qualification: Valid ordinary sequential nonoverlapping stack accesses; no external state change between the two instructions.
prefix.argument_position: Zero is at callee-entry ESP+4, after the pushed near-return offset; recognizing it as a formal argument requires a callee ABI.

opaque_call.relation: Opaque(M2,S2,registers,segments,modes,flags) may fault, diverge, transfer elsewhere, or reach a continuation state C.

suffix_relation.premise: The captured 59 C3 pair is reached and both instructions normally complete with default 32-bit operands and SS.B=1.

ret.runtime_linear_destination: Derived from CSc.base and Q if valid; not recovered here.

suffix_relation.EAX_final: Ac; these two local instructions do not assign EAX, but Ac has no established return-value meaning.
suffix_relation.other_GPRs: Unchanged from C except ECX and ESP; this says nothing about preservation from function entry.
suffix_relation.arithmetic_flags: Unchanged from Fc by the pair; flags may already have been changed by the opaque call.
suffix_relation.explicit_ordinary_memory_effects: The pair reads the two stack words and performs no explicit data-memory store.
suffix_relation.no_continuation: If the callee does not reach this pair, no suffix postcondition is asserted.
suffix_relation.C04FDE: Unqueried arithmetic end-plus-one only; C3 has no fallthrough and has no immediate cleanup operand.

SS_B_0_relation.condition: The code/default operand width remains 32 bits but SS.B=0 at the relevant instruction.
SS_B_0_relation.addressing: Use p=SP with u16 pointer updates and four-byte operands/accesses; each full access must be valid.
SS_B_0_relation.prefix: PUSH: SP=u16(SP-4), store zero; CALL: SP=u16(SP-4), store rho.
SS_B_0_relation.suffix: At continuation SP=p: ECX=Read32(Mc,SSc,p); Q=Read32(Mc,SSc,u16(p+4)); SP_final=u16(p+8).
SS_B_0_relation.upper_ESP: The suffix SP updates preserve the continuation upper 16 bits of ESP; no carry into that half is asserted.
SS_B_0_relation.EIP_operand: The near return still loads a 32-bit EIP under the separately assumed 32-bit operand mode.
SS_B_0_relation.cross_call: The continuation upper ESP half and stack mode need not equal their entry values.
SS_B_0_relation.full_ESP_equations: The SS.B=1 full-ESP equations are not valid substitutes for this SP relation.

unproven_claims.ECX_equals_zero: Requires the continuation read V=0; the earlier push neither fixes T nor preserves Mc at that location across the call.
unproven_claims.whole_function_stack_balance: Only ESP_final=T+8 is derived. A one-near-return caller relation ESP_final=S+4 additionally needs T=S-4.
unproven_claims.original_return_destination: Requires Q=R0 and appropriate code-segment mapping plus proof that initial R0 was the intended caller return offset.
unproven_claims.return_value: No local EAX assignment establishes the callee EAX value, its type, or a return convention.
unproven_claims.Cxx_callable_ABI: No parameter/register convention, hidden inputs, stack cleanup, nonvolatile preservation, types, global effects or unwind contract is recovered.
unproven_claims.saved_no_return_false: A saved analysis flag is not an execution guarantee and does not discharge any opaque-call obligation.
